params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. Two fish tacos on a foil-lined tray: golden fried fish in corn tortillas, piled with shredded cabbage, sour cream and orange chipotle aioli, topped with pink pickled red onions, with lime wedges on the side. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
